captions.detailed: A farm swing gate consisting of a main cylindrical timber-style post and a wide rectangular frame gate. The gate features three horizontal rails, two vertical end posts, and a diagonal cross-brace. It is attached to the main post via two distinct hinges, allowing the entire gate panel to swing or revolve smoothly on a vertical axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a farm swing gate on a pintle-post hinge. The model must feature a thick cylindrical post as the base, and a revolving gate panel made of a rectangular frame with horizontal bars and a diagonal cross-brace, connected by two vertically aligned hinges.
captions.factory: Create a cylindrical post using a cylinder primitive. Construct the gate panel by assembling box primitives for the vertical end-stems, three horizontal rails, and a diagonal brace. Connect the gate panel to the post by defining two hinge joints using revolute articulations aligned vertically along the Z-axis.
